summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, announcing that its 2026 Notice of Annual General Meeting (AGM) has been made available to shareholders. The AGM is scheduled for September 24, 2026, in London. The filing is a routine notification of an upcoming shareholder meeting, including administrative details such as venue, time, and access to the notice. No special-situation event is presented in this document—no M&A, capital returns, restructuring, or other transformative corporate activity is disclosed. The filing simply conveys standard meeting logistics and regulatory compliance information to shareholders and regulators.
